seo.title: FAQ {'|'} Monjiz
seo.description: Answers to common questions about pricing, delivery time, confidentiality, and revisions

items.question: How is pricing determined?
items.answer: Pricing is flexible and set per request based on scope and detail. We send a clear quote after reviewing your request, and work only begins after your approval.

items.question: How long does delivery take?
items.answer: It varies by request type and scope. We give you a specific delivery date as part of the quote itself.

items.question: Is my data and request confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Your data and request details are never shared with a third party, and are stored with strong protection — see the privacy policy for details.

items.question: Can I request revisions on delivered work?
items.answer: Yes, as long as the revision stays within the originally agreed scope. Anything beyond that is treated as a new request and may need additional pricing.

items.question: My request doesn't fit any of the four categories, what do I do?
items.answer: Choose "Other" in the request form and describe your request clearly — we'll review it and get back to you.

items.question: Can I attach files to my request?
items.answer: Yes, you can attach up to 3 files (images, PDF, Office documents), 10MB max per file.

items.question: Does the service require any in-person presence?
items.answer: No, all our services are delivered fully remotely from start to delivery.
